items.synopsis: On MX and EX platform replacing the line-cards may trigger FPC to be offlined due to unreachable destinations
items.description: On Junos MX and EX9200 platforms when replacing MPC2E-NG and EX9200-40XS with MPC3E-NG, SCBE3 and EX9200-MPC cards, inserting the new MPC may cause new and other line cards to go offline due to unreachable destinations. This happens due to some registers on the fabric card is not properly updated once the fabric channel bonding has changed and impacts the traffic.

items.synopsis: PTX10001-36MR enters booting loop when a system reboot or software upgrade initiated reboot is performed
items.description: PTX10001-36MR enters booting loop when the system reboots as part of system reboot or software upgrade procedure. A rare timing issue prevents the initialisation of internal component causing the issue.

items.category: Track PRs in BGP BMP area & is part of BGP inside RPD.
items.synopsis: High CPU utilization due to BMP to be running with the longest and highest run count
items.description: In a rare situation, BMP might falls into a loop processing rib-in RM update messages but none of message being sent out. It can hog CPU for long time until the BMP station state is bounced. Since BMP task has low priority, it will yield CPU if there are other tasks jump in. So BMP will only hog CPU when system is idle and won't block other important tasks.

items.category: Track PRs in BGP Flow Spec area & is part of BGP inside RPD.
items.synopsis: The inetflow6 routes are not installed on firewall filter table using BGP FlowSpec
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with BGP FlowSpec, ipv6 routes are installed in flow route table but not in firewall filter table. FlowSpec routes are blocked and dropped leading to traffic disruption. This is especially seen when BGP UPDATE Message does not include "Filter: Packet Length filter" within "FLOW_SPEC_NLRI" from BGP flowspec server thereby inetflow6 routes do not have "Action(s)"

items.category: EVO L3 routing for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: On Junos Evolved QFX platforms IPv6 traffic forwarding failure with prefix /56
items.description: On QFX series switches working on Evolved, IPv6 traffic forwarding failure is seen with route prefix /56.

items.category: PFE COS features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: More than 8 forwarding-classes cannot be configured with CBF
items.description: On PTX10001-36MR, error will be displayed when we commit more than 8 forwarding-classes (FCs) which are configured with Class Based Forwarding (CBF) even though the product supports upto 16 forwarding-classes configured with CBF.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: IFBD lookup Failure in DLU, packets needs to be dropped rather than learned through control IFL in packetio.
items.description: Related to L2 level security fix.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss for few seconds will be observed after restarting l2-learning process on L3 VxLAN gateway
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, in the EVPN-VXLAN( Ethernet Virtual Private Network- Virtual Extensible Local Area Network) scenario, traffic loss for few seconds would be observed when a user restart l2-learning process on a Layer-3 VXLAN gateway. This happens because of timing issues in the kernel, which mistakenly delete MAC routes of its associated devices instead of updating them in the table. The traffic from devices with those MAC addresses won't flow until the system is back on track and syncing properly.

items.synopsis: Traffic drops observed in the L2Circuit/L2VPN scenario
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX platforms, traffic drops are observed when an update is processed in the L2Circuit (Layer 2 Circuit)/L2VPN (Layer 2 VPN) scenario on executing the CLI command "clear isis database all". The issue happens due to the reuse of the same port resource when PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) receives the deletion and addition of port resources.

items.synopsis: RLI53385: GL: 16xSFP56: After ungraceful removal of 16xSFP56 in slot 2, 3; Packet dropped due to congestion seen
items.description: On a ungraceful removal and plugging back of IOCARDs on Gamora, there would be packet drops due to congestion.

items.category: JDHCP daemon for EVO platform to handle DHCP protocol
items.synopsis: EVO(EVPN Fabric): DHCP packets are getting relayed even after deleting the dhcp relay configuration from the leaf
items.description: With a router running Junos Evolved software and in the ERB EVPN VXLAN scenario. The leaf router/switch continue to forward DHCP packets even after removing the "dhcp-relay configuration" from the IRB interface.

items.synopsis: Deletion of classifier/rewrite with import statement, along with some extra rules leads to the cosd process crash
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms configured with COS (Class-Of-Service), when classifier/rewrite has imported rules from a parent and has its own rules on top of it, it is observed that if the import is deleted, the imported rules are not cleaned up properly. This applies to the rules that add to the parent's base rules, as well as to those rules that overwrite the parent's base rules and results in cosd process crash.

items.synopsis: Multiple processes crash when more than 150 vlan entries are configured in vlan-id-list under AE IFL
items.description: Continuous crash of multiple processes is observed in Junos Evolved platforms when the vlan-id-list configuration under AE IFL has 150 or more vlans configured.

items.synopsis: The dot1xd process crash will be observed due to an assert condition
items.description: On the Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with MACsec (Media Access Control Security ) bounded-delay, the incorrect MACsec bounded delay stats timer ref count will result in an assert condition leading to the dot1xd process crash. The dot1xd process crash will flap the MACsec sessions.

items.category: EVO category to hold IPv6 Neighbor Discovery Protocol and re
items.synopsis: The egress traffic loss occurs when IPv6 Router Solicitation (RS) packets are processed just after interface flap(down/up)
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, the the egress traffic loss occurs when IPv6 Router Solicitation (RS) packets are processed just after interface flap(down/up).

items.synopsis: Configuration archival through FTP, doesn't work with presence of firewall filter on the loopback interface even when FTP ports are allowed.
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, the configuration archival through FTP doesn't work with presence of firewall filter on the loopback interface. EPSV (ftp in passive mode) mode was used by default during FTP configuration archival. This causes the file transfer to fail even when standard FTP ports are permitted in the firewall filter. The fix for this PR changed ftp to operate in EPRT mode by default like Junos.

items.synopsis: Neighbor device details not listed under snmp walk [ipNetToMediaPhysAddress]
items.description: On Junos Evolved platforms, SNMP walk table (ipNetToMediaPhysAddress) is not updated when a neighbour entry is configured.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop in between EVPN hosts might be seen when "vlan-id none" is configured and any commit changes done under "protocols mpls"
items.description: On all Junos Evolved ACX and PTX platforms, Traffic drop in between EVPN hosts might be seen when "vlan-id none" is configured and any commit changes done under "protocols mpls". The intermittent drops are due to MAC label refresh post commit change.

items.synopsis: xSTP configured interface will remains in discarding state
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved Platforms, when an interface is added inside RSTP (Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol), VSTP (VLAN Spanning Tree Protocol), MSTP (Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol) or STP (Spanning Tree Protocol), because of STP port creation fail from l2cpd (Layer 2 control protocol daemon), port will remains in discarding state. This leads to traffic impact.

items.synopsis: Connectivity between static and LDP signaled pseudowires broken in VPLS after upgrade and results in VPLS traffic drop
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evovled platforms, when there is a upgrade and also when one mesh group of routing instance is substring of other, the connection between static and LDP (Label Distribution Protocol) signaled psuedowires is broken will lead to traffic drop.

items.synopsis: An invalid remote neighbor address is shown for IPv6 LDP with session-protection configured
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, for targeted and non-targeted IPv6 LDP sessions, the IPv6 loopback address is not learned in the right format, and session-protection is not enabled.

items.synopsis: RPD CPU utilization is 100% when configured with virtual router-advertisement for AE interface
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms rpd ( Routing protocol daemon) CPU utilisation reaches 100% when configured with virtual router-advertisement for AE interface due to which AE member link flaps.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: The rpd crash is observed due to segment fault
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, when no acknowledgment is received from PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) within timeout results in the rpd (Routing Process Daemon) crash. This issue happens when routes requesting acknowledgment do not receive acknowledgment leading to segment fault.

items.synopsis: RSVP incorrectly determines the outgoing interface resulting in the rpd crash
items.description: On Junos platforms, the rpd (Routing Protocol Process Daemon) crash is observed when LSP (Label-Switched-Path) terminates on the incorrect outgoing interface. The issue happens because RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) incorrectly determines the outgoing interface that the ResvTear applies to.

items.synopsis: PTX10008: When NSR Enabled and FMBB Knobs are configured and if SIB is Offline/Online casue resiliencyd core
items.description: PTX10008: When NSR Enabled and FMBB Knobs are configured and if SIB is Offline/Online casue resiliencyd core

items.synopsis: Config login class with allow/deny-configuration-regexps not working as expected with Routing-instances
items.description: Config login class with allow/deny-configuration-regexps not working as expected with Routing-instances

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: After deleting commit scripts with transient changes, the changes do not take effect
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7100-32C / ACX7100-48L / ACX7509 / PTX10001-36MR / PTX10003 / PTX10004 / PTX10008 / PTX10016 platforms, when a commit script with transient configurations is deleted, daemon does not see the change after commit.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The device goes into configuration locked state due to stale mgd
items.description: The device is went into config locked state due to stale mgd. For netconf sessions with , if ungraceful exit happens, the lock is not released. There is auto cleanup supported for such cases, But it is not triggered under problem conditions as faced in this PR. This leads to device remain in locked state due to stale entry. "request system logout pid " can be used for cleanup and to recover from this state.

items.synopsis: ACX reports "/psm/0/ hwdre/0/cm/0/ psm_mcu /psm0/psm_cml_cmd_fault" even though the PSM is in working order
items.description: ACX reports "/psm/0 /hwdre/0 /cm/0 /psm_mcu/ psm0/psm_cml_cmd_fault" even though the PSM is in working order

items.synopsis: Observing spikes in 1pps performance during long run testing
items.description: On long Hour performance(more than 24 hours) testing spikes/pattern is observed in 1pps performance report.

items.category: EVO Layer-2 switching for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: QFX5130/QFX5700: In some specific configuration commit sequences, intermittent traffic drop is seen on a few VXLAN enabled VLANs.
items.description: On QFX5130/QFX5700 platforms, intermittent traffic drop might be seen when VXLAN configurations and UFT host-profile configuration are changed in the same commit operation. This problem will not be seen if the UFT profiles are changed in a separate commit

items.synopsis: LAG interfaces will take longer than usual to come up in a scaled scenario with ALB
items.description: On PTX10001, PTX10004, PTX10008 and PTX10016 platforms, if Adaptive load balancing (ALB) is configured on LAG interface, the LAG interfaces will take longer than usual to be up if they are all enabled in the same commit. LAG interfaces get stuck in 'attached' state. This issue happens in a scaled Link Aggregation Group (LAG) (~65 ae ) scenario.

items.synopsis: pfestatsd process may fail to restart when running out of file descriptors
items.description: pfestatsd process was running out of file descriptors when there are 16 FPCs in the system as the number of concurrent connections exceeded 1024

items.synopsis: Flabel sequencing is not correct leading to traffic loops and congestion in the PFE on PTX platforms
items.description: Flabel sequencing is not correct leading to traffic loops and congestion in the PFE on PTX platforms

items.synopsis: Balerion-FT:Firewall: aftmand-bx cores continuously at JexprHandleFilter:: updatePfeInst, when attaching filter which has 5-tuples+FC+DP+TTL+Fragment+ifl matches
items.description: If a filter does not compile due to an unsupported match combination (i.e. the set of matches configured in the filter is not supported by hardware), attaching this filter to an interface will cause aftmand-bx to crash.

items.synopsis: Error messages are populating "getQosRewriteHwMapIdFromIflIndex" and interface ifd queue stats traffic is going to the wrong queue
items.description: ACX7509 :: Observing Error messages are populating "getQosRewriteHwMapIdFromIflIndex" and verify interface ifd queue stats traffic is going to wrong queue"

items.synopsis: Unknown unicast IPv4 Traffic received with UDP destination port 8503 will be flooded back to Source PE
items.description: On the Junos Evolved ACX7K platform, the split horizon rule is broken when an IPv4 packet with destination UDP port 8503 is received on the system over the Ethernet VPN (EVPN) /Layer-2 network. This will result in the traffic being sent /flooded to the source PE router. The below filter can be seen incrementing during the issue. pfe> show evo-pfemand filter counters filter-name __BfdLspMplsSelfPingTrap_unit0__ Counter-Name Packets BytesBfdLspMplsSelfPingTrap_unit0-rule 125016 99578126

items.synopsis: [sflow][ACX7100-48L] outputPort field is reported as 0 in exported samples for sflow ingress sampling
items.description: [sflow][ACX7100-48L] outputPort field is reported as 0 in exported samples for sflow ingress sampling

items.synopsis: Functionality provided by arp/ndp publish argument doesn't work on all Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: Functionality provided by publish argument for static arp and static ndp configuration is not working on all Junos OS Evolved platforms.

items.synopsis: monitor interface or show interface does not display the interface description
items.description: Enhancement in EVO platform for the command "monitor interface" and "show interface" include interface description

items.category: Paragon Active Assurance Test Agent Plug-In
items.synopsis: Junos Evolved system is running, but all interfaces are off
items.description: CC web UI does not show interface when test agent running on 7509-a.

items.category: Express PFE MPLS for EVO platforms
items.synopsis: Unknown sensors are added in PFE on all Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, any client (in this case it was LDP), a route (with a sensor attached) is added and deleted immediately. This is a timing issue and easily reproducible.

items.synopsis: MPLS LSP stats will not increment post the rpd restart
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms post rpd restart using cmd "restart routing immediately" mpls lsp statistics will not work.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crash is observed when MVPN PE receives PIM join messages from the remote peers
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, when MVPN (Multicast Virtual Private Network) configured device receives PIM join or IGMP report from the remote peer installs route in next-hop and not in multicast composite next-hop, causing the rpd process to crash.

items.category: PTX10K Line Card specific interface PRs
items.synopsis: Interface stay in link DOWN state when using third party optics
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms and MX ULC based line cards, interfaces will stay DOWN when using third party vendor optics, due to an incorrect programming of EEPROM when plugged into the device.

items.synopsis: Ungraceful FPC removal from chassis causing "hwdre" crash and process stops leading to FPC in fault state
items.description: On all Junos Evolved PTX10004/PTX10008/PTX10016 platforms, when FPC(Flexible PIC Concentrator) is removed ungracefully from the chassis, hwdre daemon crash is observed causing FPC to be in fault state.
